A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same work, with matching sections, equations, figures, tables and references. Neither contains an appendix; supplementary visualizations mentioned in both texts are outside the supplied files.

before.justification: Sections 4–5 report original surface-reconstruction experiments on five datasets, along with component ablations and sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: Sections 4–5 retain the original benchmark experiments and ablations, including the revised DFAUST results in Table 4.

M1.justification: The BSP mappings, GDO procedure, loss functions and end-to-end training framework in Section 3 remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ShapeNet, D-FAUST, SRB, 3DScene and KITTI, including the same street and pedestrian scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding benchmark tables, visual comparisons and BSP/GDO ablations. No baseline is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same input sampling, evaluation metrics and evaluation-point counts, including 300-point shape inputs and 1024-point SRB inputs. No experimental setting change accompanies the Table 4 revision.

E4.justification: Section 5 retains the same BSP, GDO and loss ablations, input-size robustness analysis and KNN sampling sensitivity study, with unchanged results and visualizations.

E5.justification: Table 4 retains the same 5th/50th/95th-percentile reporting. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: In Table 4, the Ours DFAUST CDL2 × 100 values change from 0.133 to 0.019 at the 50th percentile and from 0.019 to 0.133 at the 95th percentile. The 5th percentile remains 0.007 and NC remains 0.914. Other results are unchanged; no rerun or protocol change is documented.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7 and their accompanying mathematical definitions and reasoning are unchanged. No assumptions, proofs or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same BSP/GDO contributions and state-of-the-art reconstruction claims.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations remain unchanged. Section 4.2 still claims best DFAUST performance across all metrics despite the revised values; no qualification or limitation is added.

D1.justification: Architecture descriptions, neighborhood and sampling parameters, loss weights and project-page access information are unchanged. No implementation or reproducibility details are added.

R1.justification: Section 2, the 77 numbered reference entries and the positioning relative to prior methods retain the same content.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v1, 31 March 2025, to v2, 24 May 2026. Body wording, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 4 moves the 95th-percentile bold emphasis from Ours to SparseOcc’s 0.034. All 11 figure images and their placements match, and table structures, captions and overall layout are retained.

improvement.justification: Table 4 removes the impossible percentile ordering in the Ours row: 0.007/0.133/0.019 becomes 0.007/0.019/0.133, modestly improving numerical coherence. The repair is incomplete: NTPS’s percentile ordering remains inconsistent, the all-metrics superiority claim persists, and the new SparseOcc highlighting conflicts with NTPS’s smaller reported 95th-percentile value of 0.022. These reporting problems limit the gain.
